Nice One !!
Jun 2025 • Friends
It is located right in the center of famous Bui Vien street, famous for night clubs in Ho Chi Minh. During our visit in this area, we landed here for dinner. We were about 20 of us. We ordered a lot of dishes like Green Salad, Papadam, Mushroom Soup, Aloo Gobi Mattar, Chicken Garlic Kebab, Tarka Dal, Baigan Bartha, Jeera Rice, Coconut rice, Chicken Methi Kebab, Palak Paneer, Aloo Jeera, Matar Paneer, Dal Makhani along with assorted Rotis. In drinks they had limited choice like beer and vodka. However they allowed us to get our drinks from outside wine shop. In desert Gulam jamun was good.
The décor and ambiance was decent. The food was quite good. The service was fast and friendly. 
Worth trying...

Plenty of other options
Mar 2025 • Friends
I recently visited Namaste India Saigon and had an overall average experience. The atmosphere was pleasant but not exceptional — it felt comfortable, though nothing stood out as particularly special. The food, while decent, didn’t wow me; it was good but not memorable. The biggest issue, however, was the service. There was a tour group that arrived during my visit, and it seemed like there were only two waiters trying to handle everything. This made the service quite slow and a bit frustrating at times, testing my patience.

I understand it’s not always easy to manage large groups, but it definitely impacted my experience. While the food and atmosphere were fine, the service was a letdown. Returning? I’d have to think twice about it.

We went there twice!
Nov 2024 • Couples
I would highly recommend this place for Indian food in Ho Chi Minh.
Their food is really delicious and lip smacking. This is the only restaurant in our Vietnam trip which gave us complimentary water following the Indian tradition of free water to all the guests.
The ambience is warm and classy.
All the staff are well trained and attentive to your needs.
Special shout out to the host Kailash for being helpful and accomodating. He went out of his way to give us great trips to make the most of our trip in Ho Chi Minh & Vietnam.
Overall, it's a great value for money, making it a must-visit for Indian cuisine lovers in Vietnam.

Just awesome
Sep 2024 • Friends
It was the 1st meal in Ho chi Minh City. Because it was Monday, we all preferred vegetarian food for lunch. An Odia staff Jahid was allowed to prepare our Odia meal on our behalf . He offered us vegetable deep fry, simple aged rice, simple dry rotis, Odia Dalma with many vegetables, beans fry, paneer curry, mashed potatoes with fried onion and green chilies along with grinded mint leaves and grinded sweet tamarind paste. And not to mention the ginger Indian tea and the sweet dish Gulabjamun. The food was awesome. We are pleased with the hospitality , preparation, swiftness and also the taste . To put it all , it was just awesome.
